name: Componentes de Combos
query:
select
  roc.combo as "Combo:Link/Restaurant Combo:160",
  roi.combo_slot_label as "Slot:Data:120",
  roi.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:150",
  roi.item_name as "Item Name:Data:180",
  count(*) as "Times Chosen:Int:110",
  sum(roi.amount) as "Revenue:Currency:130"
from `tabRestaurant Order Item` roi
inner join `tabRestaurant Order` ro on ro.name = roi.parent
inner join `tabRestaurant Order Combo` roc
  on roc.parent = roi.parent and roc.combo_uid = roi.combo_uid
where ro.docstatus = 1
  and roi.combo_uid != ''
  and (%(from_date)s is null or %(from_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date >= %(from_date)s)
  and (%(to_date)s is null or %(to_date)s = '' or ro.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
  and (%(company)s is null or %(company)s = '' or ro.company = %(company)s)
group by roc.combo, roi.combo_slot_label, roi.item_code
order by 5 desc
